correctness.rationale: A=U+U* has exact cosine eigenvalues. Tr(A B)=2n for every prescribed-edge completion B, giving norm>=2n/||A||_1. Conjugation covariance forces sign(A) edge amplitudes to equal ||A||_1/(2n) times their prescribed signs; its scaled sign thus attains the lower bound. Equality in Hermitian trace Holder forces each nonzero A eigenvector to be an extreme B eigenvector; the only possible freedom lies on ker A, which has dimension zero except the designated even flux parity. The two parity-supported nullvectors show exact optimizers are independent diagonal kernel coefficients in [-tau,tau]. Finite cosine sums yield exact three branches. The standalone checker passed 4836 finite diagnostics; not substituted for proof.
